outcome: Microbial colonization patterns in the lower airways
cohort: 52 children with an age range of 1 day to 1 year old who underwent endotracheal intubation for elective surgery or respiratory support.
finding: Early-life bacterial colonization patterns of the lower airways are associated with gestational age and delivery mode, and these microbial communities may influence lower airway immune maturation.
mod_finding: Ureaplasma-dominated microbiota was associated with preterm vaginal delivery, and Staphylococcus-dominated microbiota was associated with preterm cesarean delivery.
